summary: Full backend + frontend validation of Store Profile & Branding (iteration 26). 23/23 pytest passing (uploads round-trip to Emergent Object Storage, file proxy, soft delete, locations CRUD with is_primary demotion, GBP mocked cycle, profile-completion, storefront deep-merge incl. cuisine_type/banner_image_url/social.whatsapp). Playwright e2e verified /admin/store-profile page (CompletionCard 59% / 22 items, LocationsCard add→edit→delete, GoogleBusinessCard connect→sync→disconnect, BrandingPreviewCard receipt+email tabs) and /admin/storefront (cuisine-type-input, social-whatsapp-input, all FileUploaders). Actually uploaded a PNG via upload-logo-input → preview rendered and 'Uploaded' toast shown.
critical_code_review_comments: uploads.py MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES=6MB check happens after full read into memory — fine at 6MB but should use streaming / Content-Length header guard if limit grows.
uploads.py PUT to object storage issues requests.put synchronously inside async handler — blocks event loop on large uploads. Consider httpx.AsyncClient or asyncio.to_thread.
store_profile.py profile-completion recomputes storefront merge on every request — consider short TTL cache for /admin pages polling every 30s.
AdminStoreProfile.js LocationsCard hours field is a raw JSON textarea — not user-friendly; consider structured day/time inputs in a follow-up.
GBP 'MOCKED' banner is visible but synced_fields always appends 'menu_link' even when storefront has no menu/brand — minor: worth only when storefront has items.
seed_data_creation: Test run creates+deletes a location ('TEST Downtown'), uploads+soft-deletes a PNG, connects+disconnects GBP. All cleaned up by tests themselves. Final state: storefront PATCH restore executed; GBP disconnected; no residual locations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_store_profile_uploads.py covers all uploads, locations, GBP mock, profile-completion, and storefront extensions. Use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var when running pytest. Emergent Object Storage is live (no delete API — soft-delete via Mongo). GBP is fully mocked.
